title: Antifungal mechanism and transcriptome analysis of Bacillomycin D-C16 against Fusarium oxysporum.
authors: Lin, Fuxing; Jiao, Yang; Jiang, Hua; Zheng, Yu; Wu, Shiqin; Zhou, Li; Ren, Xiangmei; Lu, Zhaoxin; Li, Yuanhong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究抗菌脂肽对尖孢镰刀菌的抗真菌机制，含分子对接显示其与DNA大沟结合，但核心是抗菌机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法仅简单对接，与课题关联有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Fusarium oxysporum is a globally distributed soil-borne pathogen that causes substantial economic losses in cash crops. Bacillomycin D-C16, a natural antimicrobial lipopeptide produced by Bacillus subtilis, exhibited potent fungicidal activity against F. oxysporum, with a minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) of 8 mg/L. However, the precise mechanism of its action against F. oxysporum remains uncharacterized. METHODS: In this study, we employed transmission electron microscopy (TEM) to analyze morphological and ultrastructural alterations in F. oxysporum treated with Bacillomycin D-C16 and RNA-seq profiling combined with biochemical assays to elucidate Bacillomycin D-C16's mode of action against F. oxysporum. RESULTS: TEM revealed that Bacillomycin D-C16 induced structural disruption of mitochondria in F. oxysporum. Transcriptome analysis identified 3,370 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in F. oxysporum, comprising 1,488 up-regulated and 1,882 down-regulated genes. Cluster analysis revealed significant changes in gene expression patterns: DEGs associated with mitochondrial function [including oxidative phosphorylation and citrate cycle (TCA cycle) pathways] were down-regulated, while most DEGs involved in glutathione metabolism were up-regulated. Furthermore, nearly all DEGs related to DNA replication were significantly suppressed. Biochemical assays confirmed these observations: Reduced activities of mitochondrial enzymes [malate dehydrogenase (MDH), isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH), pyruvate dehydrogenase (PDH), and complexes I-V], decreased mitochondrial membrane potential, and diminished ATP content collectively indicated mitochondrial dysfunction. Depleted glutathione (GSH) levels accompanied by elevated glutathione s-transferase (GST) activity, increased malondialdehyde (MDA) content, and accumulated reactive oxygen species (ROS) confirmed disruptions in glutathione metabolism and oxidative stress. Ultraviolet (UV) absorption spectra, fluorescence spectroscopy, and molecular docking simulations demonstrated Bacillomycin D-C16's preferential binding to the major groove of DNA, leading to abnormal DNA replication. CONCLUSIONS: These findings collectively demonstrate that Bacillomycin D-C16 inhibits F. oxysporum growth through multifaceted mechanisms involving transcriptional regulation, mitochondrial impairment, ROS accumulation, and interference with DNA replication.
abstract_zh: 背景：尖孢镰刀菌（Fusarium oxysporum）是一种全球分布的土传病原菌，对经济作物造成重大经济损失。Bacillomycin D-C16 是由枯草芽孢杆菌（Bacillus subtilis）产生的天然抗菌脂肽，对尖孢镰刀菌表现出强效杀真菌活性，其最低抑菌浓度（MIC）为 8 mg/L。然而，其对尖孢镰刀菌的作用机制尚未明确。方法：本研究采用透射电子显微镜（TEM）分析经 Bacillomycin D-C16 处理的尖孢镰刀菌的形态和超微结构变化，并结合 RNA-seq 测序及生化检测，阐明 Bacillomycin D-C16 对尖孢镰刀菌的作用方式。结果：TEM 显示，Bacillomycin D-C16 诱导尖孢镰刀菌线粒体结构破坏。转录组分析鉴定出尖孢镰刀菌中 3,370 个差异表达基因（DEGs），包括 1,488 个上调基因和 1,882 个下调基因。聚类分析显示基因表达模式发生显著变化：与线粒体功能相关的 DEGs（包括氧化磷酸化和柠檬酸循环（TCA 循环）通路）下调，而大多数参与谷胱甘肽代谢的 DEGs 上调。此外，几乎所有与 DNA 复制相关的 DEGs 均被显著抑制。生化检测证实了这些观察结果：线粒体酶[苹果酸脱氢酶（MDH）、异柠檬酸脱氢酶（IDH）、丙酮酸脱氢酶（PDH）及复合物 I-V]活性降低、线粒体膜电位下降及 ATP 含量减少，共同表明线粒体功能障碍。谷胱甘肽（GSH）水平耗竭伴随谷胱甘肽 S-转移酶（GST）活性升高、丙二醛（MDA）含量增加及活性氧（ROS）积累，证实了谷胱甘肽代谢紊乱和氧化应激。紫外（UV）吸收光谱、荧光光谱和分子对接模拟表明，Bacillomycin D-C16 优先结合 DNA 大沟，导致 DNA 复制异常。结论：这些发现共同表明，Bacillomycin D-C16 通过涉及转录调控、线粒体损伤、ROS 积累及干扰 DNA 复制的多层面机制抑制尖孢镰刀菌生长。
